settings.title: Settings
settings.languageRestart: Requires app restart to take effect
settings.clearCacheConfirm: This will delete saved content for offline use. Are you sure?
settings.syncOffline: No connection; we will try later
settings.syncNote: Your habits, kinship list and settings sync with your account. The sin-leaving program syncs only encrypted with your privacy code, if you choose so.
settings.deleteAccountBody: Your account and what is stored for it on the server are deleted for good. The data on this device stays as it is.
settings.deleted: Your account was deleted. The data on this device stays as it is.

auth.guestNote: You can use the app without an account. An account is only needed to save and sync favorites.

practice.title: My habits
practice.subtitle: Help me keep a good deed: a little that lasts, without increases that wear you out.
practice.noPlansHint: Start with one very small habit.
practice.partialHint: Any amount counts, even part of it. Make up what you missed the same day; it is never doubled tomorrow.
practice.heavyDayHint: Your habits drop to the minimum instead of stopping. Obligations come first.
practice.ramadanHint: Each habit goes up one step until {{date}}, then returns to what it was on its own. Returning is not falling short.
practice.ramadanHintNotRamadan: It is not Ramadan now. You can start a 30-day season until {{date}}; your habits then return to what they were on their own.
practice.ebbActive: Heavy day: the minimum is asked
practice.remindersHint: Notifications on this device only, for the next 14 days.
practice.permissionDenied: Notifications are not allowed. You can turn them on in the device settings.
practice.privateNote: Your habits are stored on this device. When you sign in they sync with your account.

band.excellentHint: You kept most of your days.
band.goodHint: At the beginning this is normal and good.
band.gentleHint: Come back today, even with a little: a little that lasts builds the habit.

increase.title: You can go up one step
increase.body: You have held this amount for a month. If you wish, go up one step only, to {{amount}}.

relapse.title: Start again, lighter
relapse.body: A week passed without a log, and that is fine. Come back with a lighter amount: {{amount}}, and do not rush to increase.

basis.text: A timing stated in the texts
basis.organizational: A suggestion to organise your time, not a religious timing

practice.catalogError: Could not load the habit list.

notify.kinshipBodyGeneric: Time to get in touch with {{n}} of your relatives
notify.kinshipBodyNames: Time to get in touch with: {{names}}
notify.sinBody: A moment for yourself. Open Thekra.

add.title: Help me keep a good deed
add.chooseHabit: Choose a habit to start with
add.distanceQuestion: How close are you to this habit right now?
add.farHint: I do not do it yet
add.startHint: Forming the habit matters more than doing a lot. No increase before a month of steady practice, then one small step.
add.slotsHint: Two times or more are better: if you miss the first, you catch the second.
add.slotsOneWarning: Add a second time if you can.
add.activeDaysHint: At the beginning 3 days; the rest are make-up days.

plan.deleteConfirm: The habit and its log are deleted from this device.
plan.fixHint: Log a day you forgot, or fix a wrong number. Zero clears that day.
plan.fixItBody: Finish today with whatever you can: any amount counts, and nothing is added to tomorrow.

duties.title: My duties and roles
duties.intro: Before voluntary deeds: obligations first. Choose your roles, then estimate your free time per day.
duties.freeMinutes: How many free minutes do you have per day after your duties and roles?
duties.freeHint: Usually between two and five hours.
duties.load: Your habits in minutes today: {{load}} of {{free}} free minutes
duties.over: Your habits take more than half of your free time. Obligations come before voluntary deeds, so lighten them until you can keep them up.
duties.notSet: You have not set your free time yet.

practice.lead: Start very small, keep at it, and increase only once it is steady. Everything here is saved on your device first.

hub.addTitle: What would you like to add?
hub.addRelativeHint: A name or nickname, and how often to reach them.
hub.addProgram: A program to leave a sin
hub.addProgramHint: On your device only, never in a notification.
hub.dayDone: You did what today asked of you. May Allah accept it from you.
hub.dayDonePast: You did what this day asked of you. May Allah accept it from you.
hub.dayEmpty: Nothing is asked of you on this day.
hub.dayEmptyStart: The habits and relatives you add show up here on their day.
hub.futureNote: A coming day: you can see it now and log it on the day.
hub.pastNote: View only: logging here covers the last 7 days.
hub.startLead: Pick one path and start small; what you add shows up in your day here.
hub.monthTitle: How far you came this month
hub.monthLead: Open it on any day, even a day you did nothing, to stay close to your habit.
hub.presentDays_zero: Nothing logged in the last 30 days yet, and today is a good start.
hub.presentDays_one: Present on 1 of the last 30 days
hub.presentDays_other: Present on {{count}} of the last 30 days

kinship.title: Ties of kinship
kinship.privacy: Write a nickname only (e.g. my aunt). No phone number, email or link.
kinship.name: Name or nickname

errors.contactDetails: This looks like a phone number, email or link. Write a nickname only.

kinship.deleteConfirm: Removed from the list on this device.
kinship.reminders: Remind me to keep in touch
kinship.showNamesHint: Notifications appear on the lock screen; without this option the text is generic.
kinship.lead: A list on your device of your relatives and how often to reach each one. A name or nickname only, no phone numbers.

sinProgram.title: Leaving a sin
sinProgram.privacy: Everything on this page stays on your device and never appears in a notification. It leaves the device only encrypted with your code, if you choose to save it in your account.
sinProgram.choose: Choose what you want to leave
sinProgram.stageHint: Each stage lasts at least 7 days; you move on after logging 4 of them. Staying longer carries no penalty.
sinProgram.summary: In the last 30 days you logged {{days}} of 30 days.
sinProgram.remindersHint: The notification title is always «تذكرة من ذكرى» and nothing from the program appears in it.
sinProgram.wipeHint: Erases the program, your logs and your notes from this device at once; they cannot be recovered.
sinProgram.wiped: Program data deleted from your device.
sinProgram.lead: A staged program on your device: know the harm, build the alternative, change your surroundings, set limits, stay firm.
sinProgram.peopleRights: This wrongs other people: there is no gradual path. It is left, or lightened with real effort, together with restoring rights, and the program helps you with that.
sinProgram.cutOnly: Here the program is for leaving it, helped by means and alternatives.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.offsetHint: If the month starts earlier or later in your country than in the Umm al-Qura calendar.
calendar.empty: No occasions in the coming days.
calendar.subscribeHint: A public calendar with no personal data; it updates itself in your calendar app.
calendar.openFailed: Could not open the calendar app.
calendar.dayEmpty: No sunnah occasion on this day.

vault.title: Encrypted backup
vault.save: Save the program encrypted in your account
vault.saveHint: To open it on another device. It is encrypted on your device with a code you choose, so nobody can read it, not even us.
vault.warning: Keep this code safe: it cannot be recovered if you forget it, and nobody can read your program without it, not even us.
vault.rememberHint: The unlock key is kept in the device's secure storage, so you do not need the code each time on this device.
vault.unlockTitle: You have a program saved encrypted in your account
vault.saved: Saved encrypted in your account, updated after each log.
vault.working: Encrypting… this can take a few seconds.
vault.signInHint: If you sign in, you can save the program encrypted in your account and open it on another device.

errors.tooShort: The privacy code must be at least 8 characters.
errors.weak: This code is easy to guess. Choose a phrase of two or more words, or a code without repeats or runs.
errors.mismatch: The two codes do not match.
errors.exists: A program is already saved in your account. Open it with its code first.
errors.missing: No program is saved in your account.
errors.failed: That did not work, try again.
